source_type: 2026-07-23 Congress session 193 HTML tallies manually transcribed in earlier ACH20 C08; not nominal original nor independent capture
method: For each of four votes, yes_share_pct=100*yes/(yes+no+abstain); compare separate per-vote shares with total-weighted pooling by expediente. Each ballot denominator is counted categories only, not all MPs.
limitations: All four records were previously exposed in ACH20 C08; not a new source or a scientific novelty grade
As-of and original nominal JSON/XML bytes unavailable, first public timestamp unknown
Observations are not a random cohort; no causal inference, no confidence interval, no generalization
A single expediente is NOT a single vote; pooled counted ballots are not unique individuals
